items:
Welcome to Inlet Retreat! This beachy abode features 3 beds and 2.5 baths situated in Grande Pointe - right between Rosemary and Panama City Beach. Grande Pointe offers an amazing community pool overlooking Lake Powell, and you're less than 1 mile from the largest beach access point on 30A. Relaxing evenings outside are all within reach! The home boasts outdoor Adirondack loungers and an amazing fire pit, perfect spot to cozy up after a long beach day. Great for families or couples! Sleeps 8!

▶1st Floor Highlights:
- No gear, no problem. We've got plenty of beach gear for your trip to the beach! 4 umbrellas, 4 beach chairs, 2 coolers, towels, toys, and a beach wagon too!
- 4 complimentary adult bikes included in your rental. Perfect for cruising to Rosemary - just 1.5 miles to Rosemary favorite, Playa Bowls. The BEST Acai bowls!
- Open concept layout, including a spacious kitchen with granite countertops and modern stainless-steel appliances
- Large kitchen island seats up to four, and a large wooden dining table can comfortably accommodate up to 6.
- Back porch seating on first floor, perfect for sipping your morning coffee! - We've got you covered on coffee too! Complementary coffee and standard drip coffee maker await!
- Adirondack chairs and fire pit await in the back yard
- Weber Charcoal Grill also available

▶2nd Floor Highlights:
- Primary bedroom - King size bed with an attached En Suite. The shower here is a 'Must-See!'. Large sleek glass-enclosed shower with double vanity and seating area. Additionally, you can step out onto the private balcony attached to the main bedroom and soak up some fresh air.
- Guest bedroom: The second bedroom has a comfortable queen-size bed and shares a second bathroom with a shower/tub combo.
- Bunk bedroom: The third bedroom is a cozy bunk bedroom with two full beds.

▶Additional fun features:
- Starter kit for everything you'll need: paper towels, toilet paper, linens, towels, dish soap, laundry pods, etc.
- All bathrooms come fully equipped with Public Goods body wash, shampoo, and conditioner
- Family friendly! Keep the baby gear at home :) We can provide a pack n play, highchair, and baby gate.
- Full access to Grande Pointe community pool which overlooks Lake Powell.
- ⭐️ NEW ⭐️ Fun perks now available for Kalos' guests. Now offering, 20% off all Sculpt Studio classes at the Big Chill. Contact us for details!

▶Minutes to the Shore:
- Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: (3 min drive, .9 miles away) the largest public beach access in Walton County, is located just half a mile away and can be easily reached. This access point provides various amenities such as public restrooms, outdoor showers, ample parking, and seasonal lifeguard services.
- Phillips Inlet Beach Access - (0.6 miles away) You can cross over HWY 98 on 'N Walton Lakeshore Drive', and that runs you right into the beach access.
- Lupine Beach Access - (0.9 miles away) You can cross over HWY 98 on 'N Walton Lakeshore Drive', and that runs you right into the beach access at Phillips. Lupine is located at the end of Walton Magnolia Ln.

Other things to note:
- Parking is available in the driveway for two cars. There is no street parking available.
- The word is out! 30A is one of Florida's best vacation spots. Unfortunately, more visitors means less parking options. Additional parking spaces are the responsibility of the renter. We recommend looking into nearby storage facilities who offer long term parking options in their lots.
- Minimum age to rent the home is 23.
- Apologies, no furry friends are allowed at the home. We appreciate your understanding on this.
- Vacation disruptions can be a bummer. While it doesn't happen often, you may experience issues with Wi-Fi or construction on 30A. We are not responsible for any disruptions to the Wi-Fi service or any construction that may affect your experience. Please note that such occurrences are beyond our control, and we appreciate your understanding and patience in these matters.

description: Located in Panama City Beach, this vacation home is near a water park and on a lake. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Kayaking, snorkeling, and parasailing offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with hiking nearby.

reviews.text: My wife and I have been coming to the Panama City Beach area for years now, but I think we've finally found our mainstay vacation rental. Everything was great from the hospitality to the location. We truly enjoyed biking to the beach each morning to watch the sunrise and in the evenings for the sunsets. The home had everything we needed to be comfortable during our stay- and our host was super-communicative. We're already looking forward to booking our next visit.

reviews.text: We had a great experience @ Inlet Retreat. Upon arrival spotless, very clean and fully equipped for our stay. Location is excellent with beach, restaurants, shopping all within reasonable driving distance. If you wish to walk, public beach access is nearby as well as many shops and restaurants. A lot has changed since my last visit 30+ years ago…but pleasantly surprised with all the growth. Will definitely come back again… will not wait 30+ years. That’s for sure!!!
